create_paired_features: create paired MSA features across multiple protein chains by aligning sequences based on species and similarity
pair_sequences: pair MSA sequence indices across chains by matching species and sorting by sequence similarity
merge_homomers_dense_msa: merge identical protein chains into a single dense MSA by concatenating features along the residue dimension
merge_features_from_multiple_chains: merge MSA features from multiple chains by concatenating or block-diagonalizing based on pairing flag
concatenate_paired_and_unpaired_features: concatenate paired and unpaired MSA features into a single unified MSA per chain
